content: दार्ष्टान्त {%a.%} (-ती|{%f.%}) दार्ष्टान्तिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) ¦ Explained or illustrated by a दृष्टान्त <ab>q. v.</ab>, that which is the subject of an illustration (उपमेय); स्वापस्य दार्ष्टान्तिकत्वेन विवक्षितम् <ls>Śaṅkara.</ls> --{%a.%} One who explains by using a simile as a proof.
